breakthrough_tracks.title_zh: 单基因遗传缺陷与缺失蛋白的源头修复
breakthrough_tracks.subtitle_zh: 从“提心吊胆终身服药/等待突发”走向“一次修复致病根源”

master.name_en: prenatal-onset spinal muscular atrophy with congenital bone fractures
master.definition_en: A rare genetic motor neuron disease characterized by decreased or absent fetal movements, congenital proximal and distal joint contractures (consistent with arthrogryposis multiplex congenita), and multiple congenital fractures of the long bones. Further manifestations are neonatal respiratory distress, severe muscular hypotonia, areflexia, dysphagia, congenital heart defects, and dysmorphic facial features. Muscle biopsy shows increased fiber-size variation and grouping of larger type I fibers. The disease is usually fatal in infancy due to respiratory failure.
synonyms_en: spinal muscular atrophy with congenital bone fractures
mondo_categories: disease of genetic or genomic mechanism

breakthrough_tracks.title_zh: 睡梦与突发危象的实时监测预警
breakthrough_tracks.subtitle_zh: 在数分钟至数小时黄金窗到来前，提前发出异常信号
breakthrough_tracks.painpoint_zh: 以遗传性易栓症、急性肺栓塞、主动脉夹层、恶性心律失常和脑出血为代表的急症，平时毫无征兆，往往在睡梦中或静息状态下几分钟内危及生命——家人根本来不及反应。
breakthrough_tracks.direction_zh: 需要发展连续无创可穿戴微循环/血氧/心电多模态传感器、血液微凝血活性快速试纸，结合 AI 在异常触发前几小时识别微血栓与高危信号并立即叫醒预警。
breakthrough_tracks.ai4ls_entry_zh: 时序多模态生理异常检测 + 血液高凝状态前置生物标志物发现 + 低成本家系表型筛查算法。

breakthrough_tracks.title_zh: 急诊极危重期的快速再通与器官细胞保护
breakthrough_tracks.subtitle_zh: 把“几分钟决定生死”的抢救窗口拓宽成“几小时可救回”
breakthrough_tracks.painpoint_zh: 对急性心梗、脑梗死、脓毒性休克、急性肝衰竭与热射病而言，哪怕送到急诊室，微血管再灌注损伤、细胞因子风暴和不可逆线粒体坏死仍会在短时间内夺走生命。
breakthrough_tracks.direction_zh: 研发免复杂配型的超快精准溶栓与导管微取栓器械、阻断微血栓级联炎症风暴药物，以及在缺血缺氧期守住心肌与脑神经元存活的细胞保护剂。
breakthrough_tracks.ai4ls_entry_zh: 急性多器官微循环级联动力学建模、急诊快速炎症/凝血表型分型、老药新用紧急器官保护筛选。

master.definition_en: Autosomal recessive limb girdle muscular dystrophy type 2E (LGMD2E) is a subtype of autosomal recessive limb girdle muscular dystrophy characterized by a childhood to adolescent onset of progressive pelvic- and shoulder-girdle muscle weakness, particularly affecting the pelvic girdle (adductors and flexors of hip). master.definition_en: Progressive nodular histiocytosis is a rare, normolipemic, non-Langerhans cell histiocytosis characterized by progressive growth of multiple to disseminated, asymptomatic skin lesions that range in appearance from yellow plaques to coalescence-prone red-brown papules, nodules and pedunculated tumors up to 5 cm in size, located typically on the face, trunk and extremities (and rarely on conjuctiva and mucous membranes). Characteristic microscopic findings include a storiform spindle cell infiltrate in the deep dermis with xanthomatized macrophages and some Touton cells in the upper dermis. It is usually not associated with systemic disease.

curated.lethality_detail_zh: 好发于中老年（中位发病年龄70–75岁）的髓系克隆性肿瘤，兼具骨髓增生异常(MDS)的血细胞减少与骨髓增殖性(MPN)的单核细胞持续升高（>0.5×10^9/L且占比≥10%）；约15%–30%患者可向急性髓系白血病(AML)转化，并发重度感染、致命性出血或高白细胞淤滞时可在数周内恶化。
curated.treatability_summary_zh: 异基因造血干细胞移植(allo-HSCT)是目前唯一潜在治愈手段，但因患者多高龄，仅少数年轻体能好者可耐受移植；绝大多数患者依托去甲基化药物（阿扎胞苷/地西他滨）及羟基脲支持治疗控制症状、延缓向AML转化，总体中位生存期约2–4年（低危可达5年以上，高危CMML-2仅约1–1.5年）。

clinical_management.acute_emergency_protocol_zh: 1) 增殖型CMML白细胞极度升高(>100×10^9/L)伴呼吸困难、意识模糊或视物模糊（白细胞淤滞症）：立即静脉水化、予羟基脲快速降白细胞并必要时行白细胞单采术，切忌未降白细胞前大量输注红细胞加重血液黏滞; 2) 血小板极度减低(<10–20×10^9/L)伴活动性出血或发热：急诊输注单采血小板及广谱抗感染。

non_drug_therapies_zh: 初诊务必行骨髓形态学、染色体核型及髓系NGS基因检测（必查ASXL1/NRAS/RUNX1/SETBP1以CPSS-Mol危险度分层，并排除BCR-ABL及PDGFRA/B重排）
无症状低危(CMML-0/1)患者可定期观察随访，避免过早化疗

research_progress.breakthroughs_and_trials_zh: 1) WHO第5版(2022)及ICC分类将CMML诊断阈值单核细胞下调至≥0.5×10^9/L，实现更早期精准识别“寡单核细胞型CMML”; 2) 靶向粒细胞-巨噬细胞集落刺激因子(GM-CSF)单抗Lenzilumab联合阿扎胞苷(PREACH-M 2/3期研究)与JAK1/2抑制剂芦可替尼(针对增殖型脾大)在RAS通路突变人群展示积极信号; 3) 口服去甲基化药物Decitabine/Cedazuridine(Inqovi)极大提升老年患者居家治疗便利性。
research_progress.key_unmet_needs_zh: 1) 去甲基化药物虽可改善血象，但极少能清除克隆或阻止最终向AML转化，且高危ASXL1/RAS突变患者仍易早期耐药; 2) 老年患者难以耐受异基因造血干细胞移植; 3) 尚无针对CMML特异性靶点的获批靶向新药。

breakthrough_tracks.subtitle_zh: 在数分钟至数小时黄金窗到来前，提前发出异常信号
breakthrough_tracks.painpoint_zh: 以遗传性易栓症、急性肺栓塞、主动脉夹层、恶性心律失常和脑出血为代表的急症，平时毫无征兆，往往在睡梦中或静息状态下几分钟内危及生命——家人根本来不及反应。
breakthrough_tracks.direction_zh: 需要发展连续无创可穿戴微循环/血氧/心电多模态传感器、血液微凝血活性快速试纸，结合 AI 在异常触发前几小时识别微血栓与高危信号并立即叫醒预警。

master.name_en: right superior vena cava connecting to left-sided atrium
master.definition_en: Right superior vena cava connecting to the left-sided atrium is a rare, congenital vascular malformation of the major vessels characterized by the right SVC passing medially and dorsally to the aortic root and draining into the left atrium. Patients usually present a right-to-left systemic venous blood shunt which may manifest with arterial hypoxemia, cyanosis, exercise dyspnea, clubbing of the fingers, palpitations, murmurs and/or potentially fatal brain abscess. Association with other cardiac anomalies has been reported.

master.definition_en: A rare vascular condition characterized by the formation of a thrombus (blood clot) in the renal vein of a newborn infant, typically within the first 28 days of life. This condition can cause renal (kidney) ischemia, and may lead to kidney damage, swelling, and potential loss of kidney function. Neonatal renal vein thrombosis (NRVT) can affect one kidney (unilateral) or both kidneys (bilateral), with the severity of symptoms often depending on the extent of the clot and the number of affected kidneys.

breakthrough_tracks.title_zh: 单基因遗传缺陷与缺失蛋白的源头修复
breakthrough_tracks.subtitle_zh: 从“提心吊胆终身服药/等待突发”走向“一次修复致病根源”
breakthrough_tracks.painpoint_zh: 许多遗传病并非细胞坏了，只是基因编码少了关键一环（如 SERPINC1 缺少抗凝血酶“刹车蛋白”、SMN1 缺乏、凝血因子或酶缺陷），让患者自出生起就暴露在高危或渐进衰退中。
breakthrough_tracks.direction_zh: 推进高精度体内 CRISPR 碱基/先导编辑、低免疫原性肝/神经靶向病毒载体（AAV）与脂质纳米颗粒（LNP）递送，以及患者自体干细胞精准修复移植，让身体自己恢复生产正常蛋白。
breakthrough_tracks.ai4ls_entry_zh: AI 指导低脱靶编辑器设计、肝脏/心肌/神经组织特异启动子预测、蛋白功能残基致病性建模。
